name: Junior Camp Counselor Volunteer
what_you_do: Help AquaCamp counselors run summer camp for young kids. You help manage the room, lead programs and get to know campers.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 14 to 17. Competitive. Two full 8 hour days a week for the summer term (June 1 to July 31 in 2026).
deadline_text: The 2026 applications were due February 28, 2026 at 5 PM. Expect a similar late winter deadline for 2027 (not posted).
how_to_apply: Send in a form with a video. Also send in a recommendation form. A Level 2 background check is required.
notes: Parents are asked to let the teen be the main contact. Fingerprint fees are reimbursed for those who finish. Max 3 excused absences.
